BiblicalUsage: Tsôrᵉphîy is the word the Bible uses when it means the goldsmith. In Nehemiah 3:31, After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith's son unto the place of the Nethinims.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Tsôrᵉphîy still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
